newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 77.0 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 77.0 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 77.0 billion marks at this week's tender at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent, the same rate that has prevailed since August.
A repo pact for 74.9 billion marks expires today, Wednesday, so a net 2.1 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 283.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 27.2 percent of bids made.
